flagged.evidence: The Definition first fixes arbitrary bond dimensions D_0,...,D_N≥1, then claims: “Every vector in a finite tensor product of these site spaces has an exact open MPS representation.” With N=2, d_1=d_2=2, and D_0=D_1=D_2=1, every represented coefficient matrix has rank at most 1 because the bond factors through C. The vector (|00⟩+|11⟩)/√2 has coefficient matrix I_2/√2 of rank 2, so it has no representation with those fixed dimensions. Proof step 1.1 chooses bond dimensions through successive SVDs but does not establish the claim for arbitrary fixed D_j; the claim needs suitable dimensions or a sufficient-rank hypothesis.
